title: ICSI December 2026 Examination Enrollment Opens Soon!
content:
# ICSI December 2026 Examination Enrollment Opens Soon!

Ek important update hai Company Secretary (CS) students ke liye! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne December 2026 session examinations ke liye enrollment process ki start dates announce kar di hain.

Here are the key dates to keep in mind:

*   **Announcement Date:** August 25, 2026.
*   **Enrollment Start Date:** The online window for enrollment, addition of groups, and claiming exemption based on higher qualification will open on **August 26, 2026**.
*   **Last Date (Without Late Fee):** Apne enrollment ya group addition applications **September 25, 2026** tak bina late fee ke submit kar sakte hain.
*   **Last Date (With Late Fee):** Late fee ke saath enrollment ya group addition applications submit karne ki akhri tareekh **October 10, 2026** hai.
*   **Last Date for Higher Qualification Exemption:** Higher qualification ke basis par exemption apply karne ki last date bhi **October 10, 2026** hai.
*   **Last Date for Enrollment Services (e.g., Change of Centre/Group/Medium):** Examination-related services jaise center, group, ya medium change karne ki last date **November 21, 2026, (Upto 16:00 Hrs)** hai.

Students ko advise kiya jaata hai ki woh last-minute rush se bachne ke liye jaldi se jaldi apna form submit karein.
